apps.localizedDescription:
YALA (Yet Another LuCI App):

YALA (Yet Another LuCI App) is an open-source mobile client for managing OpenWrt routers. It connects directly to your router using LuCI JSON-RPC, ubus, and standard OpenWrt system services, allowing you to monitor real-time bandwidth, manage connected devices, run network diagnostics, configure wireless radios, manage AdGuard Home DNS sinkhole, monitor VPN tunnels (WireGuard, OpenVPN, Tailscale), control Smart Queue Management (SQM/QoS), inspect storage, and update packages directly from your phone or tablet.

YALA is purpose-built for mobile, tablet, and touch-first form factors:

• Smartphones: Android (Android 8.0 Oreo up to Android 15/16) and Apple iPhone (iOS 14.0+).
• Tablets & iPads: Android Tablets and Apple iPads with dedicated wide-screen multi-column layouts and adaptive split views.

versions.localizedDescription:
This is an experimental community beta release of Yet Another LuCI App for Apple iOS devices (iPhone and iPad), built from version 2.6.0 (Build 232).

Highlights:

• Firmware Upgrade Center: Check official OpenWrt updates, review preservation impact, and flash safely.
• JSON Config Export: Export router settings (firewall, DHCP, Wi-Fi, DDNS) with privacy redactions.
• Router Speed Test: WAN speed test engine with multi-stage sampling.
• UI Revamps: Redesigned wizards, improved dialog responsiveness, and cleaner layouts.
• Localization improvements: Improved the localization coverage.
• Performance & Stability: Memory optimizations, smoother rendering, and overall stability fixes.

This is an unsigned iOS package ( .ipa ). It can be sideloaded onto compatible iPhones or iPads running iOS 14.0+ using standard sideloading tools such as:

• AltStore / SideStore.
• Personal Apple Developer account signing or enterprise signing.
